title: Sections of a pulled-back sheaf over a descended affine etale object on a limit of qcqs schemes are the colimit of the sections at the stages (Stacks 09YQ in degree 0)
statement:
Let $I$ be a directed set and $(X_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ whose transition morphisms $f_{ii'}:X_i\to X_{i'}$ ($i\ge i'$) are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], every $X_i$ being quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with limit $X=\varprojlim_iX_i$ and projections $f_i:X\to X_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $0\in I$, $\mathcal G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $(X_0)_{\Et}$ (an object of $\Mod((X_0)_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]) and $V_0\to X_0$ an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $V_0$ affine, an object of $(X_0)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For $i\ge0$ put $V_i=V_0\times_{X_0}X_i$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] along $f_{i0}$; an object of $(X_i)_{\Et}$), $V=V_0\times_{X_0}X$ (along $f_0$; an object of $X_{\Et}$), $\mathcal G_i=f_{i0}^{-1}\mathcal G$ and $\mathcal G_\infty=f_0^{-1}\mathcal G$, the inverse images of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] ($f_{00}=\mathrm{id}$, $\mathcal G_0=\mathrm{id}^{-1}\mathcal G$). For $i'\ge i\ge0$ let $\rho_{i'i}:\mathcal G_i(V_i)\to\mathcal G_{i'}(V_{i'})$ be the composite of the unit $\eta:\mathcal G_i\to f_{i'i,*}f_{i'i}^{-1}\mathcal G_i$ on sections over $V_i$, which lands in $(f_{i'i}^{-1}\mathcal G_i)(V_i\times_{X_i}X_{i'})$ by the definition of the direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], of the composition isomorphism $c:f_{i'i}^{-1}f_{i0}^{-1}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\sim}f_{i'0}^{-1}\mathcal G$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], and of the restriction along the canonical isomorphism $V_{i'}\xrightarrow{\sim}V_i\times_{X_i}X_{i'}$ of iterated fibre products over $X_{i'}$; let $\rho_i:\mathcal G_i(V_i)\to\mathcal G_\infty(V)$ be defined in the same way from the unit of $f_i^{-1}\dashv f_{i,*}$, the composition isomorphism $f_i^{-1}f_{i0}^{-1}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\sim}f_0^{-1}\mathcal G$ and the canonical isomorphism $V\xrightarrow{\sim}V_i\times_{X_i}X$ over $X$. Then $\rho_{i''i'}\circ\rho_{i'i}=\rho_{i''i}$, $\rho_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ and $\rho_{i'}\circ\rho_{i'i}=\rho_i$ for $i''\ge i'\ge i\ge0$, and the induced map of $\Lambda$-modules
$$\varinjlim_{i\ge0}\mathcal G_i(V_i)\longrightarrow\mathcal G_\infty(V)$$
is bijective; in particular every $t\in\mathcal G_\infty(V)$ is $\rho_i(s)$ for some $i\ge0$ and some $s\in\mathcal G_i(V_i)$. (Stacks, Etale Cohomology, Theorem 09YQ (theorem-colimit) in degree $p=0$, applied to the system $(V_i)_{i\ge0}$ with limit $V$ and the system of sheaves $\mathcal G_i|_{V_i}$; this is the special case used in the paragraph 'Fully faithful' of the proof of Lemma 09YU.)
